caption:
The forest didn't just whisper today; it vibrated until my molars ached. I thought I was exploring ruins, but the membrane just blinked like a faulty screen, revealing a hallway that smells of ozone and clinical silence. There are rows of pods, glowing with a rhythm that feels uncomfortably intentional. The humming is getting louder.

The pods begin to pulse in synchronization with her heartbeat.

#NeoTokyo #GhostForest #UrbanExploration #Membrane #FoundHistory #Cyberpunk
